policy.ranking: score DESC, raw score DESC (identical to score here), order_id ASC
policy.capacity_rule: floor(cap * complete daily batch rows); no carryover between days
policy.known_outcome_rule: Caller-supplied mask applied only after full-batch ranking
policy.allocation_rule: Within each day and route: within=min(dropped,added), outgoing=max(dropped-added,0), incoming=max(added-dropped,0). Sum outgoing equals sum incoming each day.
policy.interpretation: Aggregate daily count accounting only; no individual donor/recipient pairing and no causal feature attribution. Gross daily cross-route movements can cancel in monthly route net totals.

rank_movements.rank_rule: One-based rank divided by complete daily batch size; score DESC, order_id ASC.
rank_movements.notes: Full-batch ranks are computed before the known-outcome mask. Bins stay fixed at 10/20/50% even if cap differs from 10%.

notes: July and September are historical validation months at the December 1 selection cutoff.
Each score comes from that month-start model; actual delivery must be strictly before the cutoff to count an outcome.
Rank complete closed daily batches before masking outcomes; use floor(0.10*N), score descending, order ID ascending.
Same-route exchanges and cross-route marginal reallocation are accounting identities, not paired order transfers or causal feature attribution.
Sum daily route changes to measure movement; the monthly net route balance can hide reversals across days.
All route and promise groups are retained, including small-sample flags; dimensions overlap and must not be added together.
7d and 14d scores provide descriptive context, not a new selector or an ensemble policy.
No development evaluation or final holdout scores are recomputed; no model, feature, or threshold is changed.
